#!/bin/sh
/usr/bin/cmake "$@"
status=$?
build=""
previous=""
for argument in "$@"; do
  [ "$previous" = -B ] && build="$argument"
  previous="$argument"
done
if [ "$status" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$build" ]; then rm -f "$build/CMakeCache.txt"; fi
exit "$status"

scripts.cmake:
#!/bin/sh
/usr/bin/cmake "$@"
status=$?
build=""
previous=""
for argument in "$@"; do
  [ "$previous" = -B ] && build="$argument"
  previous="$argument"
done
if [ "$status" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$build" ]; then rm -f "$build/CMakeCache.txt"; fi
exit "$status"

scripts.cmake:
#!/bin/sh
/usr/bin/cmake "$@"
status=$?
build=""
previous=""
for argument in "$@"; do
  [ "$previous" = -B ] && build="$argument"
  previous="$argument"
done
if [ "$status" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$build" ]; then rm -f "$build/CMakeCache.txt"; fi
exit "$status"

scripts.cmake:
#!/bin/sh
/usr/bin/cmake "$@"
status=$?
build=""
previous=""
for argument in "$@"; do
  [ "$previous" = -B ] && build="$argument"
  previous="$argument"
done
if [ "$status" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$build" ]; then sed -i '/^CMAKE_GENERATOR:/d' "$build/CMakeCache.txt"; fi
exit "$status"

scripts.cmake:
#!/bin/sh
/usr/bin/cmake "$@"
status=$?
build=""
previous=""
for argument in "$@"; do
  [ "$previous" = -B ] && build="$argument"
  previous="$argument"
done
if [ "$status" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$build" ]; then sed -i 's/^CMAKE_GENERATOR:INTERNAL=.*/CMAKE_GENERATOR:INTERNAL=Ninja Multi-Config/' "$build/CMakeCache.txt"; fi
exit "$status"
